research.name: simpleParallax.js
research.note: Scroll parallax for plain img and video tags in React or vanilla JS, with orientation, scale and delay settings.

effects: scroll parallax applied directly to img and video tags by translating a scaled image inside an overflow-hidden wrapper
configurable parallax orientation, scale, delay and overflow mode
